status_note: This IS the shipped, trained v1 (1,495,179 training rows; see training_dataset_artifacts). 'baseline' denotes the 5-head XGBoost architecture, NOT a scaffold or placeholder. Renamed from 'trained-baseline' for clarity (FW-023 question #50).
spec_changelog: rev2 (2026-06-09): DOC-ONLY. Model ONNX bytes, feature code, and feature VALUES are unchanged. (1) Added explicit has(k) formulas for the 5 win_* heuristic features + a feature_formula_reference block — clarifies what build_window_feature_vector already computes. (2) Completed candidate_anchor_generation: union over ALL fretted notes + the {lowest,highest,median} reduction rule (answers FW-023 #49). (3) status 'trained-baseline' -> 'released-baseline' (FW-023 #50).

source_breakdown.classclef_pieces: ClassClef sequential fingering (3000+ classical pieces with GPIF LeftFingering)

padding_strategy: Right-pad short windows with PAD_VALUE in every per-note feature slot. Windows shorter than 3 notes are NOT recommended for inference (the model will degrade).

feature_descriptions.n{slot}_string: 0-based string index for note at window slot (0=high_e). PAD_VALUE=-1 if slot empty.
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_fret: Fret of note at slot (0=open, 1..22 fretted). PAD_VALUE=-1.
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_pitch: MIDI pitch of note at slot (0..127). PAD_VALUE=-1.
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_fret_rel_min: fret - window_min_fret. Negative for open strings when window has fretted notes.
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_fret_rel_anchor: fret - candidate_anchor. Positive when note is above the anchor.
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_is_repeated_pos: 1 if an earlier slot in this window had the same (string, fret).
feature_descriptions.n{slot}_has_legato: 1 if note has hammer_on/pull_off/slide technique tag.
feature_descriptions.win_num_notes: Number of real notes in the window (not counting padding).
feature_descriptions.win_min_fret: min over fretted notes; 0 if all open.
feature_descriptions.win_max_fret: max over fretted notes; 0 if all open.
feature_descriptions.win_num_strings: Count of distinct strings touched in the window.
feature_descriptions.win_candidate_anchor: The candidate anchor fret being scored for this row.
feature_descriptions.win_index_anchor_required: has(0). 1 if any fretted note sits exactly on the anchor fret (anchor+0). NOTE: this is presence-of-a-note-AT-the-anchor, NOT win_min_fret==anchor.
feature_descriptions.win_ring_natural_for_anchor_plus_2: has(2). 1 if any fretted note sits exactly on anchor+2. NOTE: exact presence, NOT max_fret>=anchor+2, and unrelated to win_contains_chord.
feature_descriptions.win_pinky_natural_for_anchor_plus_3: has(3). 1 if any fretted note sits exactly on anchor+3. NOTE: exact presence, NOT max_fret>=anchor+3.
feature_descriptions.win_pinky_used_without_lower_anchor: has(3) and not has(0) and not has(1). 1 if a note sits on anchor+3 while no note sits on the anchor or anchor+1 fret (PRIOR — model can override).
feature_descriptions.win_would_shift_hand_if_no_pinky: has(3) and not has(2) and not has(1) and not has(0). 1 if a note sits on anchor+3 and nothing sits on anchor, anchor+1, or anchor+2 (no lower fret anchors the hand, so dropping the pinky note would force a shift).

feature_formula_reference.note: DOC-ONLY clarification added in spec_revision 2; these formulas describe what build_window_feature_vector already computes (unchanged since v1 training). has(k) := any fretted note in the window has fret == candidate_anchor + k.
feature_formula_reference.win_pinky_used_without_lower_anchor: has(3) and not has(0) and not has(1)
feature_formula_reference.win_would_shift_hand_if_no_pinky: has(3) and not has(2) and not has(1) and not has(0)

input_schema.format: float32 array of shape [batch_size, 74] in the exact order produced by `src.features.phrase_window_features.feature_names(WINDOW_SIZE=5)`.

output_schema.format: Multi-head bundle. The ONNX file contains 5 finger-classifier heads (slot_0..slot_4) plus 1 anchor head.

outputs.name: slot{slot}_finger__probabilities
outputs.type: softmax over finger classes [open, index, middle, ring, pinky]
outputs.interpretation: Probability that note at window slot `slot` is fingered with class i, GIVEN the candidate anchor encoded in the input.

outputs.name: anchor_head__probability
outputs.interpretation: Probability that the candidate_anchor encoded in the input is the correct ground-truth anchor for this window.

output_schema.usage_pattern: For each candidate anchor in candidate_anchors(window), build a feature row, run the bundle, then aggregate cost = anchor_loss + sum(slot_finger_losses).

inference_protocol.step_1: Slide a window of `window_size` notes across the score (non-chord notes only).
inference_protocol.step_2: Compute candidate_anchors(window) -> list of up to 4 candidate frets.
inference_protocol.step_3: For each candidate, build feature vector and run the ONNX bundle.
inference_protocol.step_4: Pick the candidate that maximizes anchor_head_prob - alpha * mean(slot_finger_NLL_over_uncertain_slots) (alpha tunable, default 1.0).
inference_protocol.step_5: Decode the slot finger probabilities under the chosen anchor as the prediction for each note in the window.
inference_protocol.step_6: For overlapping windows (stride < window_size), average the per-note probabilities across windows before argmax — this gives smoothed phrase-level decisions.

candidate_anchor_generation.rule: For EVERY fretted note in the window, candidate ∈ {fret-0, fret-1, fret-2, fret-3} intersected with [1, 22], deduplicated. This is the union over ALL fretted notes — NOT the {min, min-1, min-2, min-3} subset of the lowest note only.
candidate_anchor_generation.reduction_when_over_max: If the deduped union has more than max_candidates entries, keep exactly {lowest, highest, median} where median = sorted_candidates[n // 2]. (This is the only reason the union can exceed max_candidates yet the protocol still says 'up to 4'.)
candidate_anchor_generation.worked_example: Window with fretted frets {7,5} -> union {2,3,4,5,6,7} (6>4) -> reduced to {2,5,7}. Window with {2,2,2,4,2} -> {1,2,3,4} (exactly 4, no reduction) — which is why anchor 4 is a valid candidate and the 'apache_4_wrong' calibration case exists.

training_sources.golden_set: golden_set_v1.jsonl in this handoff dir — NOT used at training, only at evaluation

known_limitations: v1 is a 5-head XGBoost baseline; it does not see across windows so phrase-level coherence relies on overlap-averaging at inference time.
Anchor head is binary (correct / incorrect) not ranked — for windows with multiple defensible anchors the scores may be close.
Trained on classical + acoustic sources; metal/jazz coverage limited until DadaGP integration ships.
Pinky-role priors are HEURISTICS encoded in the feature vector — the model can override them but they bias training when data is thin.
WINDOW_SIZE is fixed at 5 in v1. Phrases longer than 5 notes need overlapping windows.

biomechanical_fallback_contract.fretwise_responsibility: After ML prediction, FretWise MUST run the deterministic validator (same set of rules as in `src/processors/validator.py`). If any constraint is violated (same finger on different frets, span > MAX_FRET_SPAN, non-contiguous partial barre), fall back to rule-only fingering for that window.
